required_changes: Evolve the existing runtime/ink BrushRuntime into the single common Brush session implementation; do not create a parallel Brush engine.
Add renderer-neutral BrushInputBatch BrushPreviewDelta BrushCommitIntent and output sink/hub contracts.
Keep the R1 one-shot perfect-freehand evaluator as the permanent reference oracle.
Add an incremental Vector preview evaluator whose move-time append path does not call the full-history one-shot evaluator.
Separate confirmed and predicted Brush session state; prediction is preview-only and replaceable.
Freeze same-session ordered execution through BrushPreviewDeltaReady with no mandatory C1-C0-C2 queue/thread hop.
Add a bounded preview mailbox or equivalent handoff with latest-wins semantics for superseded non-terminal revisions and reliable terminal/cancel/retire events.
Add reliable non-droppable canonical BrushCommitIntent handoff semantics independent of preview presentation.
Add CanonicalVisible receipt identity handling so pen-up does not retire preview and stale receipts cannot retire newer preview.
Move Web and Android BrushRuntime/session ownership into common InkPlayground composition.
Replace Windows raw-pointer-derived preview geometry with consumption of common BrushPreviewDelta or a transitional common preview sink.
Remove or neutralize the obsolete pointer-level arc_input_fanout_adapter from the authoritative C2 path.
Add workload counters/timing for incremental work, preview queue/backpressure and long-stroke complexity.
Preserve C0 C1 and R1 behavior.
forbidden_changes: Change AutoIntent MultiInk GesturePriority or C0 routing semantics
Change C1 PlatformPointerBatch pointer lifecycle or coordinate-unit semantics
Modify pinned R1 perfect-freehand reference behavior or known limitation identity
Create a second Brush engine alongside BrushRuntime
Add Dear ImGui or Debug Controller implementation
Implement R2 common Skia canonical Vector renderer architecture
Redesign C4 Arc PreviewBackend Presenter backend selection or native low-latency backend
Change canonical semantic schema ObjectKind StrokeRecord or Operation authority
Put persistence sync RuntimeScene or tile work on the preview critical path
Claim D0 R2 G4.5 Gate or release PASS

authorized_mutation_scope.other_production_paths: FORBIDDEN unless execution returns TASK_PACKAGE_DEFECT or AUTHORITY_CONFLICT to CONTROL_REVIEW

preserved_work.rule: Preserve C1 ingress and C0 routing. Preserve R1 one-shot evaluator as reference. Replace only downstream Brush ownership/hot-path behavior.

performance_constraints: No move-time append may call the full-history one-shot evaluator.
For repeated deterministic local geometry, max per-append work at 2048 samples must be <= 1.25x the max at 512 samples for the same batch size.
Preview handoff storage is bounded and inspectable.
No synchronous wait for Arc GPU/presentation completion on the Brush hot path.
No canonical document/scene/persistence/sync work on move-time preview path.
Common CPU InputBatchAccepted to BrushPreviewDeltaReady targets <=1.0 ms p95 where qualification hardware is available; this target is not a product guarantee.
